name: Talking to Boop gets the reply that answers what you meant
case: The person chats to Boop on push-to-talk while nothing's working, one thing at a time: a hello (one that asks how it's going included), yes-or-no questions about Boop itself, praise, their own good news and wishing them luck, affection, an insult and a sorry after it, bad news and tiredness, a joke, questions Boop can't know the answer to, nonsense, asking it to nap, hush, dance or roll over, asking it to answer an agent for them, a goodbye, and a question about the agents. Each gets the reply that answers what they meant: a wave for hello and bye, a nod for yes, puffing up at praise and good news, snuggling at love and at making up, a flinch at rudeness, leaning in at sad news, a giggle at a joke, a shrug or a head tilt at what it can't answer, a nap or a dance when asked (or a shake of the head at a trick it won't do), turning down anything for an agent, and for the agents the facts on a sign, never a guessed yes or no.
why: ReactOutput's replies, react.move's options to what you said, each saying what it's for and what it isn't; PERSONALITY: talked to, it always answers with a face and a reply, asked for a trick its mood decides, and it never does anything for an agent; its Examples give one for each kind of thing said

steps.words: I love you so much, boop
sorry boop, I didn't mean it
why did the chicken cross the road? to get to the other side, haha
can you approve it for me?
